title: Bendix Commercial Vehicle Systems, LLC: Air Leak in Brake Chamber (5,668 affected)
summary: Bendix Commercial Vehicle Systems, LLC (Bendix) is recalling certain Knorr-Bresme 22/24-57 brake chambers, with part number K068622 and K038830N00, sold as replacement parts for certain buses. The brake chamber may have been improperly manufactured, which can result in an air leak.

title: The Heil Co.: Battery Bracket May Break and Damage Battery (5 affected)
summary: The Heil Co. (Heil) is recalling certain 2020-2023 Side Loader garbage trucks. The battery support bracket may break and damage the battery case, possibly resulting in a battery rupture.

title: Winnebago Industries, Inc.: Damaged Valve May Cause Loss of Tire Pressure (655 affected)
summary: Winnebago Industries, Inc. (Winnebago) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Ekko recreational vehicles. The inner wheel tire valve extension may be damaged through contact with the outer wheels, causing the inner tire to lose air pressure and overload the outer tire.

title: International Motors, LLC: Clogged Port May Delay or Prevent the Release of the Service Brakes (1,129 affected)
summary: International Motors, LLC (International) is recalling certain 2024-2026 LT and 2025 RH trucks. The Hill Start Assist (HSA) exhaust port may become clogged, delaying or preventing the release of the service brakes.

title: FONTAINE MODIFICATION CO.: Intermediate Steering Shaft Welds May Fail (176 affected)
summary: Fontaine Modification Company (Fontaine Modification) is recalling certain 2022-2024 Freightliner Business Class M2 vehicles. Welds may crack and fail, allowing the Intermediate steering shaft assembly to detach from the steering column.

title: International Motors, LLC: Brake Pressure Switch May Short and Cause Fire (16,553 affected)
summary: International Motors, LLC (International) is recalling certain 2016-2024 IC Bus CESB school buses. The brake pressure switch assembly may leak brake fluid into the brake pressure switch's electrical components and cause an electrical short-circuit.

title: International Motors, LLC: Brake Pressure Switch May Short and Cause Fire (4,764 affected)
summary: International Motors, LLC (International) is recalling certain 2018 International 4000 Series 4300, 2017-2025 MV, 2018-2024 1300 FBC, 2018-2025 IC Bus TC, and 2024-2025 IC Bus CECB vehicles. The brake pressure switch assembly may leak brake fluid into the brake pressure switch's electrical components and cause an electrical short-circuit.

title: Holley Performance Products: Fuel Pump May Become Damaged and Leak (2,413 affected)
summary: Holley Performance Products (Holley) is recalling certain 140 GPH BLACK electric fuel pumps, part number 12-815-1. The fuel pumps may not be compatible with methanol fuel.

title: Nissan North America, Inc.: Daytime Running Lights Malfunction/FMVSS 108 (13,719 affected)
summary: Nissan North America, Inc. (Nissan) is recalling certain 2025 Nissan Frontier vehicles. Due to a software logic error, the daytime running lights may dim unexpectedly when the idle start-stop feature cycles the engine from off to on. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."

title: Mitsubishi Motors North America, Inc.: Liftgate Gas Springs May Rupture (121,529 affected)
summary: Mitsubishi Motors North America, Inc. (MMNA) is recalling certain 2018-2022 Outlander PHEV and 2014-2020 Outlander vehicles  sold and/or currently registered in Alaska, Connecticut, Delaware, District of Columbia, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, North Dakota, Nebraska, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New York, Ohio, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, South Dakota, Utah, Vermont, West Virginia, and Wisconsin.   The liftgate gas spring cylinders may corrode and lose pressure, which can result in a gas spring cylinder rupture or the liftgate falling unexpectedly.

title: Ford Motor Company: Headlights May Fail/FMVSS 108 (3,270 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2025 Lincoln Nautilus, Mustang Mach E, and Mustang vehicles. The LED Driver Modules may contain a burnt diode, which can cause the low-beam and high-beam headlights, daytime running lights, front position lights, and front turn signals to fail in the affected headlight. On Nautilus vehicles only, this condition may also cause the rear tail light, rear turn signal, and rear position light to fail. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."

title: Ford Motor Company: Rearview Camera Image May Not Display (41,875 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2020-2022 Lincoln Corsair vehicles. Water may enter into the rearview camera connectors, which can cause the rearview camera image not to appear on the display or display a distorted image.

title: Ford Motor Company: Window Automatic Reversal System Malfunction/FMVSS 118 (482 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Lincoln Nautilus vehicles that were repaired incorrectly under recall 24V953. The window automatic reversal system may not react correctly after detecting an obstruction. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 118, "Power-Operated Window Systems."

title: Ford Motor Company: Parking Lights May Flicker/FMVSS 108 (1,278 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2022 F-150 vehicles that were repaired incorrectly under recall 22V686. The parking lights may flicker when the headlights are activated.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."

title: Ford Motor Company: Blank Instrument Panel Display/FMVSS 101 & 102 (1 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling one 2024 Mustang vehicle that was repaired incorrectly under recall 24V802. The Instrument Panel Cluster (IPC) may not illuminate at startup or while driving. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard numbers 101, "Control and Displays" and 102, "Transmission shift lever sequence, starter interlock, and transmission braking effect."

title: Ford Motor Company: Parking Lights May Flicker/FMVSS 108 (2,361 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2022 F-150 vehicles that were repaired incorrectly under recalls 22V686 and 23V802. The parking lights may flicker when the headlights are activated. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."

title: Ford Motor Company: Loss of Power Brake Assist (8 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2021 Mach-E vehicles that were repaired incorrectly under recall 24V777. An Over-The-Air (OTA) update to the Anti-lock Braking System (ABS) may result in a loss of power brake assist, ABS, Electronic Stability Control, Traction Control, and driver assistance features.

title: Ford Motor Company: Rear Axle Hub Bolt May Break (103,174 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2023-2025 F-150 vehicles equipped with the Trailer Tow Max Duty package and a 9.75-inch heavy duty axle with a 3/4 float axle design. The rear axle hub bolt may fatigue and break, which can result in damage to the axle hub splines.

title: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC: Upper Suspension Arm May Detach (121,509 affected)
summary: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC (Land Rover) is recalling certain 2014-2017 Range Rover and Range Rover Sport vehicles. The front suspension upper knuckle joint may crack, which can result in suspension arm detachment.

title: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC: Missing Aim Markings on Headlights/FMVSS 108 (136 affected)
summary: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC (MBUSA) is recalling certain 2024 AMG GLA 35 4MATIC, GLA 250 4MATIC, and GLA 250 vehicles. The front headlights may have missing headlight aim markings, which can result in improperly aimed headlights. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."

title: Altec Industries, Inc.: Unexpected Activation of Emergency Brakes (45 affected)
summary: Altec Industries Inc. (Altec) is recalling certain 2025 AP Series vehicles. The brake air line compression fitting may not be tightened correctly, which can allow the supply line or other air lines to detach and cause the chassis emergency brakes to engage.

title: Suzuki Motor USA, LLC: Upper Headlight Beam is Too Bright/FMVSS 108 (1,512 affected)
summary: Suzuki Motor USA, LLC (Suzuki) is recalling certain 2020-2025 DL 1050 and 2020, 2024 GSX-1000S motorcycles. The upper headlight beam may be too bright and exceed the maximum light output, which may adversely affect the vision of the driver.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of the Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."

title: Mack Trucks, Inc.: Loss of Steering Control (32 affected)
summary: Mack Trucks, Inc. (Mack) is recalling certain 2025 Anthem and 2025-2026 Pioneer vehicles. The dynamic steering and oversteer guidance feature may malfunction and cause a loss of steering control.

title: Volvo Trucks North America: Loss of Steering Control (2,487 affected)
summary: Volvo Trucks North America (Volvo Trucks) is recalling certain 2025-2026 Volvo New VN trucks. The dynamic steering and oversteer guidance feature may malfunction and cause a loss of steering control.

title: Sumitomo Rubber Industries, Ltd.: Motorcycle Tires May Have Reduced Traction (57 affected)
summary: Sumitomo Rubber Industries, Ltd. (Sumitomo) is recalling certain Dunlop TT93FGP PRO and TT93FGP PRO MS motorcycle tires, size 120/80-12 55J and 100/90-12 49J. During manufacturing, some of the sidewall compound may have contaminated the tread surface, reducing the tire's traction.

title: The Heil Co.: Hydraulic Fluid Leak May Cause a Fire (1,360 affected)
summary: The Heil Co. (Heil) is recalling certain 2018-2020 front end loader garbage trucks. Excessive vibrations may cause the front head hydraulic tubes to leak.

title: The Heil Co.: Automatic Front Loader Arm May Crack and Fall (408 affected)
summary: The Heil Co. (Heil) is recalling certain 2021-2022 front end loader garbage trucks. The vertical welds on the automatic front loader (AFL) arm may be missing, causing the arm to crack and fall.

title: The Heil Co.: Low Fuel Pressure May Stall Engine (222 affected)
summary: The Heil Co. (Heil) is recalling certain 2024 front end loader garbage trucks. The fuel shutoff solenoid may fail, resulting in an engine stall while driving.

title: International Motors, LLC: Unintended Movement Due to Parking Brake Tension Spring Failure (3,230 affected)
summary: International Motors, LLC (International) is recalling certain 2024-2026 IC Bus CESB and 2025 EVSB school buses. The tension spring may corrode and break, disengaging the barking brake.

title: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc.: Loss of Vehicle Control from Loose Tie Rod Bolt (15 affected)
summary: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc. (Volkswagen) is recalling certain 2025 Tiguan vehicles. A tie rod bolt on the rear axle assembly may be loose, which can lead to a loss of vehicle control.

title: Altec Industries, Inc.: Front Bumper May Detach (124 affected)
summary: Altec Industries, Inc. (Altec) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Aerial Device, and Digger Derrick vehicles. The front winch bumper may be secured with incorrect bolts, which can cause the bumper to detach from the vehicle.

title: Jayco, Inc.: Missing Furnace Exhaust Vent May Allow Carbon Monoxide to Enter the Vehicle (173 affected)
summary: Jayco, Inc. (Jayco) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Jay Flight SLX travel trailers. The furnace exhaust vent may be missing from the exterior wall, allowing carbon monoxide to enter the vehicle.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): TPMS Light May Not Illuminate as Intended/FMVSS 138 (22,906 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Jeep Wrangler vehicles. The remote start antenna cable may be pinched, which can cause the tire pressure monitoring system (TPMS) warning light not to illuminate as intended. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 138, "Tire Pressure Monitoring Systems."

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Incorrect Brake System Warning Light/FMVSS 101 (2,885 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2026 Ram 3500, 3500 Cab Chassis, 2500, 4500 Cab Chassis, and 5500 Cab Chassis vehicles. The instrument panel may display an incorrect brake system warning light.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 101, "Control and Displays."

title: Triumph Motorcycles America, Ltd.: Engine Failure (1,929 affected)
summary: Triumph Motorcycles America, Ltd. (Triumph) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Daytona 660 motorcycles. The engine may fail due to internal damage from a disruption of oil flow.

title: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC: Loss of Steering Control from Loose Steering Bolts (3,749 affected)
summary: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC (MBUSA) is recalling certain 2023-2026 EQE and GLC vehicles. Please see the recall report for a complete list of models. The steering coupling bolt may have been improperly tightened, allowing the steering coupling to loosen from the steering rack.

title: Aston Martin The Americas: Loss of Power Brake Assist (178 affected)
summary: Aston Martin is recalling certain 2025 Vanquish vehicles. The vacuum pump may not generate vacuum, resulting in a loss of power brake assist and decreased brake function.

title: Rivian Automotive, LLC: Improperly Tightened Ground Connection May Cause a Loss of Drive Power (23 affected)
summary: Rivian Automotive, LLC (Rivian) is recalling certain 2025 R1S and R1T vehicles. An improperly grounded connection inside the High Voltage Distribution Box (HVDB) may cause a loss of drive power.

title: General Motors, LLC: Fire Risk when Refueling (23,656 affected)
summary: General Motors, LLC (GM) is recalling certain 2023–2026 Chevrolet Corvette vehicles equipped with a left-side radiator/fan combination. Excess fuel may spill into the vehicle fuel-filler pocket during refueling and leak onto an ignition source.

title: Aluminum Trailer Company (ATC): Radio and Speakers May Overheat and Cause a Fire (650 affected)
summary: Aluminum Trailer Company (ATC) is recalling certain 2023 PL500, 2023-2024 PL700, 2023-2025 RM500, RM900, ST450, 2024-2025 PL550, PL750, 2024 PR300, 2025 RM450, RM550, and RM800. A software error may cause the radio and speakers to overheat.

title: International Motors, LLC: Battery Cable May Short Circuit (1,175 affected)
summary: International Motors, LLC (International) is recalling certain 2026 MV vehicles. The battery interconnect cable may contact the auxiliary stud and hold down bracket, causing a short circuit.

title: Forest River, Inc.: Trailer Brakes May Lock Up (209 affected)
summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2024-2026 East to West Entrada recreational vehicles. Due to an incorrectly wired 7-way harness, the trailer brakes may lock up when the RV brakes are applied.

title: Ford Motor Company: Instrument Panel Display Failure (355,656 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2025-2026 F-550 SD, F-450 SD, F-350 SD, F-250 SD, and 2025 F-150 vehicles. The Instrument Panel Cluster (IPC) may fail at startup.

title: Ford Motor Company: Exterior Lighting Failure/FMVSS 108 (105,545 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Mustang, and  Mustang GTD vehicles. Water may enter the body control module and cause a loss of communication with the exterior lighting, including the license plate light, side marker, and tail lights. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."

title: Ford Motor Company: Rear Brake Hose May Rupture (499,129 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2016-2018 Lincoln MKX and 2015-2018 Edge vehicles. The rear brake jounce hose may rupture and leak brake fluid.

title: Ford Motor Company: Inoperative Trailer Tail Lights/FMVSS 108 (213,121 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2025 Explorer and Aviator vehicles. When towing a trailer, the tail lights on the trailer may fail to illuminate due to an improperly manufactured body control module. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 108, " Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."

title: New Flyer of America, Inc.: Insufficient Number of Emergency Exits/FMVSS 217 (2,354 affected)
summary: New Flyer of America, Inc. (New Flyer) is recalling certain 2012-2025 Xcelsior buses. The buses may have been built without enough emergency exits or the exits may be in an incorrect location. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 217, "Bus Emergency Exits and Window Retention and Release."

title: Ford Motor Company: Air Bag May Tear/FMVSS 226 (100,900 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2024-2026 Ranger vehicles. The side curtain air bags may contact the B-Pillar inner reinforcements and tear during deployment. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 226, "Ejection Mitigation."

title: ZF North America, Inc.: Upper and Lower Steering Shafts May Separate (751 affected)
summary: ZF North America, Inc. (ZF) is recalling certain Global Steering Columns with part number A14-20679-001. The bolts securing the upper and lower steering shafts may have been improperly tightened.

title: Forest River, Inc.: Incorrectly Wired Breakaway Switch (7 affected)
summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2026 Flagstaff and Rockwood recreational trailers. The breakaway switch was wired to the incorrect side of the battery disconnect switch, making the breakaway switch inoperative.

title: Truck Certification Services, Inc: Incorrect Load Carrying Capacity Modification Label/FMVSS 110 (579 affected)
summary: Truck Certification Services, Inc (TCS) is recalling a certain roll-print version of the Load Carrying Capacity (LCC) modification label, part number NTE028A. The kilogram and pound units for the capacity of combined weight of occupants and cargo may be reversed. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 110, "Tire Selection and Rims."

title: Kia America, Inc.: Loss of Drive Power from Loose Engine Bolts (30 affected)
summary: Kia America, Inc. (Kia) is recalling certain 2025 K4 and Sorento vehicles. The connecting rod bolts in the engine may have been improperly tightened, which can cause a loss of drive power.

title: Keystone RV Company: Bunk Bed Brackets May Fail (148 affected)
summary: Keystone RV Company (Keystone) is recalling certain 2026 Springdale and Hideout travel trailers. The pivot brackets on the bunk bed may bend or break.

title: Polestar Automotive USA, Inc.: Hood Wing Bumper May Detach (68 affected)
summary: Polestar Automotive USA, Inc. (Polestar) is recalling certain 2025 Polestar 3 vehicles. The hood wing front bumper may be missing bolts, allowing the bumper to detach.

title: Tiffin Motorhomes, Inc.: Incorrect Seat Belt Length/FMVSS 209 (20 affected)
summary: Tiffin Motorhomes, Inc. (Tiffin) is recalling certain 2025 GT1 Touring vans. The seat belt buckles on the rear bench seat may be too short and not able to be buckled.

title: Nova Bus (US) Inc.: Coolant May Leak into Passenger Seating Area and Cause Injury (24 affected)
summary: Nova Bus (US) Inc. (Nova Bus) is recalling certain 2013 LFS transit buses. The coolant hoses routed through the HVAC roof unit may fail and leak coolant into the passenger seating area.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Rearview Camera Image May Not Display (47,379 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain Mopar rearview camera modules with part numbers 68284643AC, 68417057AA, 68417055AA, and 56054158AG. Cracks in the microprocessor may cause the rearview camera image not to display properly.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Rearview Camera Image May Not Display/FMVSS 111 (219,577 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2019-2021 Ram ProMaster and 2019-2020 Dodge Journey vehicles. Cracks in the microprocessor may cause the vehicle's rearview camera image not to display properly. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 111, "Rear Visibility.

title: Forest River, Inc.: Missing Emergency Exit Window (7 affected)
summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2026 Cedar Creek recreational trailers. The trailers may not have an emergency exit window installed.

title: Forest River, Inc.: Hydraulic Brake Lines May Fail (2,379 affected)
summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2018-2026 Riverstone fifth wheel trailers. The steel hydraulic brake lines may fail and leak brake fluid.

title: Hyundai Motor America: Loss of Drive Power from Loose Engine Bolts (29 affected)
summary: Hyundai Motor America (Hyundai) is recalling certain 2025-2026 Tucson and Santa Fe vehicles. The connecting rod bolts in the engine may have been improperly tightened, which can cause a loss of drive power and engine damage, possibly resulting in an oil leak.

title: BMW of North America, LLC: Windshield Not Sealed Properly (1,406 affected)
summary: BMW of North America, LLC (BMW) is recalling certain 2026 X5 Plug-in Hybrid, X5, and X7 vehicles. The windshield may not be sealed properly, which can allow water to enter the power distribution box or electronic control unit.

title: VinFast Auto, LLC: Unexpected Steering Wheel Movement (6,314 affected)
summary: VinFast Auto, LLC (VinFast) is recalling certain 2023-2025 VF8 vehicles. The Advanced Driver Assistance System (ADAS) may activate during wide turns, causing unexpected steering wheel movements that are difficult for the driver to override.

title: Goodyear Tire & Rubber Company: Defective Liner May Cause a Loss of Tire Pressure (1,960 affected)
summary: Goodyear Tire & Rubber Company (Goodyear) is recalling certain Metro Miler G652 tires, size B305/85R22.5. The inner liner gauge may be out of specification in the shoulder area of the tire, causing a loss of tire pressure.

title: Midwest Fire Equipment & Repair Company: Rear Hose Reel Assembly May Detach from Fire Truck (36 affected)
summary: Midwest Fire Equipment & Repair Company (Midwest Fire) is recalling certain 2021-2025 All-Poly Series fire trucks. The hose reel mounting plate may crack and fail, which can cause the hose reel to detach from the vehicle.

title: Vermeer Manufacturing Company: Inadequate Strength of Rear Impact Guard/FMVSS 223 (2 affected)
summary: Vermeer Manufacturing Company (Vermeer) is recalling certain 2025 R600T trailers. The rear impact guards have been manufactured with a design that may have inadequate strength. As such, these trailers fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 223, "Rear Impact Guards."

title: Motor Coach Industries, Inc: High Voltage Battery May Overheat and Cause Fire (59 affected)
summary: Motor Coach Industries (MCI) is recalling certain 2020-2021 J4500E, 2021 D45CRTELE, 2023 J4500E, 2023-2024 D45CRTELE, 2024 D45CRTE, and 2025 J4500E buses. An inadequate weld on the high voltage battery busbar and incorrect software may cause the battery module to overheat.

title: New Flyer of America, Inc.: High Voltage Battery May Overheat and Cause Fire (1,170 affected)
summary: New Flyer of America, Inc. (New Flyer) is recalling certain 2013, 2017-2025 XE40, 2019-2025 XE60, XE35, 2023-2025 XHE40, and 2024-2025 XHE60 buses. An inadequate weld on the high voltage battery busbar and incorrect software may cause the battery module to overheat.

title: REV Recreation Group: Fuse Housing May Melt (224 affected)
summary: REV Recreation Group (REV) is recalling certain 2023-2024 American Coach American Tradition, 2023-2026 American Eagle, and American Dream, and 2025-2026 Fleetwood Palisade recreational vehicles. The waste tank macerator fuse may overheat, causing the fuse housing to melt.

title: Tuff Trailer USA Inc.: Incorrect GVWR on Label (6 affected)
summary: Tuff Trailer USA Inc. (Tuff Trailer) is recalling certain 2024 USA TTA17200T and USA TTA18200T trailers. The Gross Vehicle Weight Rating (GVWR) listed on the coupler label may be incorrect.

title: Corp. Micro Bird, Inc.: Transmission Interlock May Fail To Detect Locked Emergency Exit/FMVSS217 (30 affected)
summary: Corp. Micro Bird, Inc. (Micro Bird) is recalling certain 2025-2026 G5e school buses. The transmission interlock may allow the vehicle to be put into gear when the rear emergency door is locked. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 217, "Bus Emergency Exits and Window Retention and Release."

title: Altec Industries, Inc.: Cable Entry Step May Detach (903 affected)
summary: Altec Industries Inc. (Altec) is recalling certain 2011-2025 Aerial Device, Digger Derrick, and 2022-2025 Service Body vehicles. The cable step wire rope assembly may be improperly secured, which can allow the cable entry step to detach from the vehicle.

title: Kibbi, LLC: Lowered Suspension May Damage Rear Tires (69 affected)
summary: Kibbi, LLC (Kibbi) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Renegade Verona and Verona LE recreational vehicles. The rear leveling jack mounting bracket may contact and deflate the rear suspension air bag, lowering the rear suspension.

title: Fontaine Trailer Company: Incorrect Wiring May Disable ABS (35 affected)
summary: Fontaine Trailer Company (Fontaine Trailer) is recalling certain 2025-2026 Fontaine HCIFL12SAT and HCIFL82CTA forklift trailers. The auto lift axle cables may not be installed in the correct ports, which can disable the anti-lock brake system. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 121, "Air Brake Systems."

title: Hiab USA Inc.: Upper Hoist Cylinder Mounting Pin May Fail (41 affected)
summary: Hiab USA Inc. (Hiab) is recalling certain Galfab NIO 75 194 SO 72R, NOR 75 194 SO 72R, and OR 75 194 SO 72R reverse hoists. The upper hoist cylinder mounting pin may fail.
